description: This file defines the class SafeObjectInputStream, which extends java.io.ObjectInputStream to provide a secure deserialization mechanism by allowing only whitelisted classes and denying certain classes based on patterns or substrings, with configuration loading from properties.

classes.name: SafeObjectInputStream
classes.description: A subclass of ObjectInputStream that introduces security measures to restrict deserialization to approved classes only, by matching class names against allowlist patterns and denylist rules.

methods.name: SafeObjectInputStream
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the security allowlist pattern based on configuration properties, falling back to default patterns.

methods.name: resolveClass
methods.description: Overrides the default method to resolve class during deserialization, applying allowlist/dennylist checks and loading class if allowed.
